video_title: Damian Lillard and Steph Curry are at the SAME LEVEL one just has had better teams 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Damian Lillard and Steph Curry's impact on team success
quotes.excerpt: I feel like just because those two are really great shooters, doesn't mean you get the same effect.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I feel like just because those two are really great shooters, doesn't mean you get the same effect. Do you guys believe if you put Damian Lillard in Steph Curry's place, we look at playstyle, we look at leadership, do you believe the same results happen? I don't think so. I think Damian Lillard is very ball-dominant and Steph Curry is very different.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: If Damian Lillard has Draymond Green and Kevin Durant, and Steph Curry, they're winning.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating if Steve Kerr's system is the reason for Steph Curry's success
quotes.excerpt: Do you think it was the playstyle or do you think Steve Kerr came in and implemented something?
quotes.quote: Do you think it was the playstyle or do you think Steve Kerr came in and implemented something? Do you think Damian Lillard is not capable of getting coached? I don't know if he's the same player as Steph Curry. As you guys say, some players play the way they play, you can't change it. I don't know if it's the same. Steph moves without the ball. I'm not saying Damian Lillard wouldn't, I just don't know.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: The necessity of moving without the ball in modern NBA offenses
quotes.excerpt: To score the ball, you have to move without the ball.
quotes.quote: To score the ball, you have to move without the ball.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Debating if Damian Lillard would win championships on the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: I think they still win. I think Damian Lillard can do what Steph Curry did in 2022.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I think they still win. I think Damian Lillard can do what Steph Curry did in 2022. Do you see what he did with the team he had?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The role of off-ball movement in the Warriors' offensive system
quotes.excerpt: The offense is around Steph Curry and the way Steph Curry plays.
quotes.quote: The offense is around Steph Curry and the way Steph Curry plays. Damian Lillard can move, but does he move like Steph Curry? One thing you can take away from Steph Curry, he doesn't move like Steph Curry, but probably Damian Lillard is better on-ball than Steph Curry is.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing the offensive danger of Damian Lillard and Steph Curry
quotes.excerpt: Damian Lillard is more dangerous with the ball. Steph Curry is dangerous without that ball.
quotes.quote: Damian Lillard is more dangerous with the ball. Steph Curry is dangerous without that ball. Steph Curry is the guy, so I don't really know if it would be totally the same each year. Would they win? Easily. They definitely would win.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Analyzing the different ways Damian Lillard and Steph Curry create advantages
quotes.excerpt: You're creating the same issues just differently. With Steph Curry, it's moving without the ball.
quotes.quote: You're creating the same issues just differently. With Steph Curry, it's moving without the ball. With Damian Lillard, he's on the ball. You're still creating advantages with hitting Draymond Green in the pocket and you still got the shooters around you. That aspect never changes. If you think put Charlie Villanueva in a situation with the Spurs or with Golden State, we're not thinking of Charlie Villanueva the same way. He's playing differently. I think Damian Lillard, if we know the way that Damian Lillard plays the game, he shoots the ball at a high clip. If there's anybody that we can replace Steph Curry with, I think all of us would choose Damian Lillard as far as shooting that basketball.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard's ability to perform against double teams
quotes.excerpt: Damian Lillard is used to seeing double teams. Now imagine with Golden State, you can't double, fam.
quotes.quote: Damian Lillard is used to seeing double teams. Now imagine with Golden State, you can't double, fam. So how elite would Damian Lillard be? And he's scoring with double teams. They're putting up 60 points with double teams. He's doing what he's doing with double teams.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of off-ball gravity on teammates
quotes.excerpt: If you have more pressure off the ball and people have to follow you, that opens up the space.
quotes.quote: If you have more pressure off the ball and people have to follow you, that opens up the space for your teammates. So that's why I'm saying he will make his teammates better.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The difficulty of getting NBA players to play off-ball
quotes.excerpt: Not every single player is willing to give up the ball and just move around.
quotes.quote: Not every single player is willing to give up the ball and just move around. Some players aren't run to, you know that.
